Projects.title: League Rank System
desc: Developed a league management and standings application using NestJS, TypeScript, TypeORM, PostgreSQL, and a web frontend integrated through Axios. Designed relational data models for leagues, teams, players, matches, and player match statistics. Implemented database migrations and seed scripts, configured cloud PostgreSQL using Neon, and prepared application deployment through Vercel. Addressed production configuration challenges involving environment variables, database connectivity, and API endpoint integration.
Projects.impact: Used the project to expand experience beyond web development.
